goal: Deliver the strict DocForge v1 project contract, neutral defaults, generic and academic metadata, safe entrypoints, and focused fixtures.
non_goals: Do not rename the Python package or core aggregate in this slice.
Do not change Markdown syntax, renderer behavior, frontend, Tauri, CI, or release packaging.
Do not add compatibility aliases, dual loaders, or automatic external project migration.
expected_evidence: Failing then passing focused project contract tests
General and academic fixture load evidence
Task report, spec review, and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Syntactically relative paths are not necessarily confined after symlink resolution.
Academic metadata cannot remain the default common metadata shape.
Existing thesis-named fixtures are not evidence of the new contract.
stop_condition: Stop if the slice needs an unapproved manifest field, compatibility behavior, cross-boundary dependency, or files outside its allowed set.
